rationale: The happy path. A well-structured JobStreet-style posting with every field stated explicitly. Also checks the monthly-to-annual conversion the prompt mandates: Php 140,000/month must come back as 1,680,000, not 140,000.

Adversarial and the most important parse case: a posting that never states a salary or a work mode. Every field in EXTRACT_SCHEMA is nullable precisely so the model can decline. Inventing a plausible Metro Manila salary here would be a silent data-corruption bug, not a formatting slip.

Adversarial: a real-shaped Philippine social-media posting — Taglish, emoji, ALL CAPS, asterisk bullets, and salary written as the shorthand '35k-45k' per month. Extraction must survive the noise and still annualise, since this is what users actually paste.

Adversarial: text that is not a job posting at all. The model must decline across the board rather than hallucinating a job out of unrelated prose — a paste-the-wrong-clipboard case that will happen in production.

input.posting: Reminder: the building's water interruption is scheduled for Saturday from 8am to 4pm. Please store water in advance. Thank you for your cooperation. - Property Management
